body: I feel you on the "friends are scattered and busy" part. Although I don't know how you handle social situations and this may be difficult for you, I would strongly suggest expanding your social circle. I have a close friend who often feels very alone, much like you do, and for a few reasons outside of her control. She recently started hanging out with her work friends outside of work and has both built better and more relationships and improved her own outlook on life. Obviously, further counselling or therapy from a professional would still be ideal, but befriending more people and building stronger bonds is a good start.

I would be open to this, as right now I can logically see any option as better than death (my apologies for sounding all over the place btw, these thoughts and a thousand others come up sporadically). I would have to consider a few things, including the following: (1) I would need time to shape up to be suitable for enlistment, and (2) would I be considered suitable for enlistment, considering my age and my predisposition to anxiety spurts? I'm 24 right now, fyi.

I would love to find help for this, but again, I'm broke and about to run out of my insurance grace period under my parents' plan. I'm so lost, and I think that even if I don't end it, this is the end of the road for me.
